summary: Status problems show honestly, new installations settle smoothly, and new managed tenants connect within minutes.

fixes.title: Undelivered status shows as a warning
fixes.text: When status reports do not reach Invardia, the Jobs page shows an amber warning with the reason, and an alert goes out at most once a day.

fixes.title: Updates wait for the install key
fixes.text: An update in the first minutes after installing shows "waiting for the install key" and ends successfully. No key a day later shows a warning pointing to Settings > Licence.

fixes.title: New managed tenants connect within minutes
fixes.text: In an MSP setup, the managing tenant allows a newly enrolled managed tenant within minutes. Until then, the managed tenant's install waits and retries by itself instead of failing.

fixes.title: Install check verifies more
fixes.text: The end-of-install check confirms that scheduled jobs are on, have run, and that status reports reached Invardia.
